description: Get the details for a node pool in the managed Kubernetes cluster.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: cluster_name
parameters.description: The cluster name.

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The node pool name.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get node agent pool by cluster name
  azure_rm_aksagentpool_info:
    resource_group: myRG
    cluster_name: testcluster

- name: Get node agent pool by name
  azure_rm_aksagentpool_info:
    resource_group: myRG
    cluster_name: testcluster
    name: default

return_values.name: aks_agent_pools
return_values.description: Details for a node pool in the managed Kubernetes cluster. Returned: always

return_values.name: availability_zones
return_values.description: Availability zones for nodes. Must use VirtualMachineScaleSets AgentPoolType. Returned: always Sample: [1, 2]

return_values.name: capacity_reservation_group_id
return_values.description: The ID of Capacity Reservation Group. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/capacityReservationGroups/crgid"

return_values.name: cluster_name
return_values.description: The cluster name. Returned: always Sample: "testcluster"

return_values.name: count
return_values.description: Number of agents (VMs) to host docker containers. Returned: always Sample: 2

return_values.name: enable_auto_scaling
return_values.description: Whether to enable auto-scaler. Returned: always

return_values.name: enable_encryption_at_host
return_values.description: This is only supported on certain VM sizes and in certain Azure regions. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: enable_node_public_ip
return_values.description: Enable public IP for nodes. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: enable_ultra_ssd
return_values.description: Whether enable FIPS node pool. Returned: always Sample: false

return_values.name: gpu_instance_profile
return_values.description: GPUInstanceProfile to be used to specify GPU MIG instance profile for supported GPU VM SKU. Returned: always Sample: "MIG1g"

return_values.name: host_group_id
return_values.description: The host group ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/hostGroups/hostgroup"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Resource ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxx-xxxf/resourcegroups/myRG/providers/Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/cluster/agentPools/default"

return_values.name: kubelet_config
return_values.description: The Kubelet configuration on the agent pool nodes. Returned: always Sample: {"cpu_cfs_quota": true, "cpu_cfs_quota_period": "100ms", "cpu_manager_policy": "static", "fail_swap_on": false, "image_gc_high_threshold": 85, "image_gc_low_threshold": 80, "topology_manager_policy": "none"}

return_values.name: kubelet_disk_type
return_values.description: Determines the placement of emptyDir volumes, container runtime data root, and Kubelet ephemeral storage. Returned: always Sample: "OS"

return_values.name: linux_os_config
return_values.description: The OS configuration of Linux agent nodes. Returned: always Sample: {"swap_file_size_mb": 1500, "sysctls": {}, "transparent_huge_page_defrag": "defer+madvise", "transparent_huge_page_enabled": "madvise"}

return_values.name: max_count
return_values.description: Maximum number of nodes for auto-scaling. Returned: always Sample: 10

return_values.name: max_pods
return_values.description: Maximum number of pods that can run on a node. Returned: always Sample: 42

return_values.name: min_count
return_values.description: Minimum number of nodes for auto-scaling. Returned: always Sample: 1

return_values.name: mode
return_values.description: AgentPoolMode represents mode of an agent pool. Returned: always Sample: "System"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Resource name. Returned: always Sample: "default"

return_values.name: network_profile
return_values.description: Network-related settings of an agent pool. Returned: when-used

return_values.name: allowed_host_ports
return_values.description: The port ranges that are allowed to access. Returned: always Sample: [{"port_end": 200, "port_start": 10, "protocol": "TCP"}]

return_values.name: application_security_groups
return_values.description: The IDs of the application security groups which agent pool will associate when created. Returned: always Sample: ["/subscriptions/xxxxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/applicationSecurityGroups/appnsg"]

return_values.name: node_image_version
return_values.description: Version of node image. Returned: always Sample: "AKSUbuntu-1804gen2containerd-2022.08.23"

return_values.name: node_labels
return_values.description: Agent pool node labels to be persisted across all nodes in agent pool. Returned: always Sample: [{"release": "stable"}]

return_values.name: node_public_ip_prefix_id
return_values.description: The Azure Public IP prefix’s ID. Returned: always

return_values.name: node_taints
return_values.description: Taints added to new nodes during node pool create and scale. Returned: always Sample: ["CriticalAddonsOnly=false:NoSchedule"]

return_values.name: orchestrator_version
return_values.description: Version of orchestrator specified when creating the managed cluster. Returned: always Sample: "1.22.11"

return_values.name: os_disk_size_gb
return_values.description: OS Disk Size in GB to be used to specify the disk size for every machine in this master agent pool. Returned: always Sample: 128

return_values.name: os_disk_type
return_values.description: The type of the OS disk. Returned: always Sample: "Managed"

return_values.name: os_sku
return_values.description: OS SKU to be used to specify os type. Returned: always Sample: "Windows2022"

return_values.name: os_type
return_values.description: OsType to be used to specify os type. Returned: always Sample: "Linux"

return_values.name: pod_subnet_id
return_values.description: The subnet ID. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxxx/resourceGroups/testRG/providers/Microsoft.Network/virtualNetworks/My_Virtual_Network/subnets/foobar"

return_values.name: power_state
return_values.description: The agent pool’s power state. Returned: always Sample: {"code": "Running"}

return_values.name: provisioning_state
return_values.description: The current deployment or provisioning state, which only appears in the response. Returned: always Sample: "Succeeded"

return_values.name: proximity_placement_group_id
return_values.description: The ID for Proximity Placement Group. Returned: always Sample: "/subscriptions/xxx-xxx/resourceGroups/myRG/providers/Microsoft.Compute/proximityPlacementGroups/proxi01"

return_values.name: resource_group
return_values.description: Resource group name. Returned: always Sample: "myRG"

return_values.name: scale_down_mode

return_values.name: scale_set_eviction_policy

return_values.name: scale_set_priority
return_values.description: caleSetPriority to be used to specify virtual machine scale set priority. Returned: always

return_values.name: security_profile
return_values.description: The security settings of an agent pool. Returned: success

return_values.name: enable_secure_boot
return_values.description: The secure boot is diabled or enabled. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: enable_vtpm
return_values.description: The vTPM is diabled or enabled. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: spot_max_price
return_values.description: SpotMaxPrice to be used to specify the maximum price you are willing to pay in US Dollars. Returned: always

return_values.name: tags
return_values.description: The tags of the node agent pool. Returned: always Sample: {"key1": "value1", "key2": "value2"}

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Resource Type. Returned: always Sample: "Microsoft.ContainerService/managedClusters/agentPools"

return_values.name: type_properties_type
return_values.description: AgentPoolType represents types of an agent pool. Returned: always Sample: "VirtualMachineScaleSets"

return_values.name: upgrade_settings
return_values.description: Settings for upgrading the agentpool. Returned: always

return_values.name: vm_size
return_values.description: Size of agent VMs. Returned: always Sample: "Standard_B2s"

return_values.name: vnet_subnet_id
return_values.description: VNet SubnetID specifies the VNet’s subnet identifier. Returned: always

return_values.name: windows_profile
return_values.description: The Windows agent pool’s specific profile. Returned: when-used Sample: {"disable_outbound_nat": false}

return_values.name: workload_runtime
return_values.description: Determines the type of workload a node can run. Returned: always Sample: "OCIContainer"
